model_plan_row.classification: Qualified historical Sanyo NP2003A primary-typical package illustration
model_plan_row.source_kind: Independent CC0 reconstruction from historical primary manufacturer drawing
limitations: Independent original reconstruction from historical Sanyo No.333H, not redistributed manufacturer CAD or proof of the actually fitted manufacturer/mould.

The original BOM explicitly calls 2SC536F TO-92. No333H identifies NP2003A as TO-92; the original nearly-square front photo is consistent with this family. Exact fitted vendor and rear profile are unverified.
Published NP body5x4x5mm, factory1.3mm pitch and0.45x0.44mm lead section are TYPICAL, not maximum toleranced clearance envelopes. F is a160-320 gain rank, not package identification.
Body curve poles/chamfers, flat-faceYdatum-1.5mm, shallow front recess, colors and smooth appearance are unsized illustrative interpretations; no body is shrunk to fit silk or other components.
Original normal model seat2.5mm/tail-2.7mm and asymmetric seat3.2mm/tail-2.5mm are retained as installation choices. Factory14mm lead length is not an installed tail-length specification.

Full0.45x0.44mm ribbon leads retain source stock, with qualified bend positions and rounded joining regions. Factory1.3mm exits are formed to existing2.54mm/asymmetric2.54-3.302mm pad axes without moving or thinning board-through leads.
Bottom-view B-C-E mapping is checked against the original symbols and preserved pad numbers1-2-3. Flat side remains negativeSTEPY/positivePCB-Y under unchanged original transforms.
Nominal drill margins are geometry checks only; source tolerances, actual lead forming, installed clearances, soldering and physical fit remain unqualified.

model_plan_row.classification: original_parametric_package_illustration_primary_max_dimensions_exact_board_pitch_undimensioned_profile_detail
model_plan_row.source_kind: Independent original drawing-derived family illustration; no manufacturer CAD
limitations: Independent original family illustration from the Abracon drawing; exact historically fitted manufacturer/part/revision is not established.
Body retains the same maximum 9.5 x 4 x 6.5 mm envelope. A maximum envelope is not an exact selected-part body size.
The printed nominal lead pitch is 2.5 +/- 0.3 mm; the existing exact 2.54 mm PCB pitch is preserved, without moving footprint or pads.
Full 0.6 x 0.35 mm maximum lead sections, original centers, 0.35 mm body datum and -2.5..0.47 mm lead extents are preserved exactly.
0.35 mm body stand-off and 2.5 mm cut tails are inherited mounting illustrations, not the drawing factory lead length of 5 +/- 1 mm.

The drawing supports a tapered side profile, softened front corners and three coated lead shoulders; the exact normalized profiles, Bezier control points, 0.96 mm shoulder base width, 1.34 mm upper width and 0.55 mm base thickness are undimensioned visual choices.
Blue coating and silver lead colors are illustrative. The original project permits an alternative 6 MHz part and notes that its color can be orange.
Frequency markings and manufacturer branding are intentionally omitted because fitted identity, typography and marking positions are unverified.
No physical seating, tolerance stack, enclosure fit, solder joint or mechanical assembly approval is implied.
model_plan_row.canonical_frame: millimeters; model X, -PCB-local-Y, outward Z; source front pin 3 at negative X

model_plan_row.classification: original_parametric_package_illustration_primary_max_dimensions_exact_board_pitch_undimensioned_profile_detail
model_plan_row.source_kind: Independent original drawing-derived family illustration; no manufacturer CAD
limitations: Independent original family illustration from the Abracon drawing; exact historically fitted manufacturer/part/revision is not established.
Body retains the same maximum 10 x 5 x 10 mm envelope. A maximum envelope is not an exact selected-part body size.
The printed nominal lead pitch is 2.5 +/- 0.3 mm; the existing exact 2.54 mm PCB pitch is preserved, without moving footprint or pads.
Full 0.6 x 0.35 mm maximum lead sections, original centers, 0.35 mm body datum and -2.5..0.47 mm lead extents are preserved exactly.
0.35 mm body stand-off and 2.5 mm cut tails are inherited mounting illustrations, not the drawing factory lead length of 5 +/- 1 mm.

The drawing supports a tapered side profile, softened front corners and three coated lead shoulders; the exact normalized profiles, Bezier control points, 0.96 mm shoulder base width, 1.34 mm upper width and 0.55 mm base thickness are undimensioned visual choices.
Blue coating and silver lead colors are illustrative. The original project permits an alternative 6 MHz part and notes that its color can be orange.
Frequency markings and manufacturer branding are intentionally omitted because fitted identity, typography and marking positions are unverified.
No physical seating, tolerance stack, enclosure fit, solder joint or mechanical assembly approval is implied.
model_plan_row.canonical_frame: millimeters; model X, -PCB-local-Y, outward Z; source front pin 3 at negative X

selected_shader_basis: Exact source colors identify nonmetal body/coating and metal leads; roughness0.42, nonemissive, nontransmissive; presentation only
